news.headline: Tokyo Electron Q2 profit jumps 27% as AI demand drives outlook, ¥150 bln buyback
news.summary: Investing.com --Tokyo Electron (TYO:8035) reported stronger second-quarter earnings on Friday as expanding investment in AI servers and data-centre infrastructure boosted demand for semiconductor equipment, while the company introduced an upbeat full-year forecast and announced a ¥150 billion share buyback.

news.headline: Asian tech stocks slump as AI rout deepens on disappointing U.S. earnings
news.summary: Investing.com-- Asian technology stocks fell sharply on Friday, extending recent declines as worries over the slowing artificial intelligence trade were amplified by weak earnings from major U.S. companies.
